rows.whatChanged: PARTICIPANT-INSTRUCTIONS ONLY, and the builder function that generates them. Two sections were added to participantInstructions() in scripts/build-census-v1-mi_setaside_trafficking-set.mjs, and they appear in data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1/mi/mi-setaside-trafficking-set--official-pdf-fill/participant-instructions.md between 'What you must do before you file' and 'What happens after you file'. (1) '## Have your item 2 statement reviewed before you file'. It opens in the participant's second person -- 'The trafficking-related factual narrative in item 2 should be reviewed by an attorney or qualified advocate before filing' -- ties it to why the packet refuses to draft item 2, and then quotes the adopted statement whole, as a blockquote, so the limits travel with the instruction rather than being paraphrased away: 'The packet carries a participant-facing instruction that the trafficking-related factual narrative should be reviewed by an attorney or qualified advocate before filing. That instruction creates no document-upload requirement, no LegalEase staff review, no proof-of-review field, no staff-approval status and no generation blocker.' A closing paragraph restates each of those five limits in plain words and says in terms that the review is the participant's to arrange, that they may file without it, and that the packet was not held back for one -- so no reader can take the instruction as an upload requirement, a staff review, a proof field, an approval status or a blocker. (2) '## What a set-aside does not reach'. Five bulleted sentences naming the Secretary of State driving record, SORA registration and reporting for a listed offence, firearm rights, restitution and the non-return of any fine, costs or other money paid, followed by the adopted source statement quoted whole: 'Not affected: The Secretary of State driving record. ... SORA registration and reporting obligations continue for a listed offense, per the note on MC 228. Firearm rights are not restored. Restitution obligations survive. The applicant is not entitled to return of any fine, costs or other money paid.' NOTHING WAS INVENTED: every proposition in both sections is a quotation of, or a direct restatement of, MI.memo.json's adopted text; no fact, deadline, exception or referral of any kind was added to it. PROVENANCE, cited in the family's own style. The family cites its records as an italic footer line -- '_Route: <routeKey> -- <authority>_'. A second italic footer line was added directly beneath it naming, for each of the two additions, the record, the track, the classification basis, the source file and the source heading: MI.memo.json track mi_setaside_trafficking, batch_decision_matrix, LegalEase_Batch_2_Legal_Research_Resolution_Memo_ADOPTED.md 'Priority issue resolution matrix / 6. Michigan' for the review instruction; and explicit_state_addendum, LegalEase-Michigan-Record-Clearing-Legal-Review.md 'TRACK 1 / FILING AND POST-FILING PROCESS' for the scope-of-relief statement. LOCKED IN THE BUILDER: seven new phrases were added to the builder's own post-write assertion list, so a future rebuild that silently drops the review instruction, any of its five limits' wording, or any of the five things a set-aside does not reach fails the build rather than shipping the packet without them.
